evidence: Targeted primary research and institutional explanations. The monetary architecture, adoption targets, constituents, reserves and holdings scenarios are proposals or synthetic calculations, not observed U institutions.

sources.title: ECB glossary: European Currency Unit and European Monetary System
sources.use: A unit composed of fixed amounts of participating currencies is distinct from a single currency; structural comparison only.

sources.title: EMU: the building of one monetary system in the European Union
sources.author: Willem F. Duisenberg
sources.read: Organising the transition to the single currency, especially ECU/euro distinction and changeover preparations.
sources.use: Member-currency basket versus single-currency transition; no European institutional or conversion rule adopted for U.

sources.title: Patterns of Invoicing Currency in Global Trade in a Fragmenting World Economy, IMF WP25/178
sources.authors: Emine Boz, Anja Brüggen, Camila Casas, Georgios Georgiadis, Gita Gopinath and Arnaud Mehl
sources.read: Abstract, section2.4 and currency-choice discussion in sections4–5.
sources.use: Settlement statistics need not identify invoice currency; pricing incentives and contract denomination matter separately.

sources.title: The international role of the euro, June2026
sources.read: Foreword, institutional discussion and payment/invoicing passages.
sources.use: Credibility, liquid asset markets and liquidity support can contribute to international currency use; no timetable or U adoption coefficient transferred.

sources.title: Foreign currency funding risk and cross-border liquidity
sources.read: Executive summary, conceptual framework and facility-access discussion.
sources.use: Currency matching differs from liquidity; hedges and funding require maturity/collateral/access analysis.

sources.title: Inaugural RAMP Survey on Reserve Management Practices
sources.read: Printed pages19–20 on reserve currency composition and liquidity/investment portfolios.
sources.use: Reserve composition can follow debt, intervention and liquidity obligations. It is separate from the U-family basket definition.

comparison_not_selected.title: MAS monetary-policy framework FAQ section2
comparison_not_selected.scope: External currency basket policy comparison; not the proposed meaning of the U basket.

comparison_not_selected.title: IMF SDR FAQ
comparison_not_selected.scope: External basket comparison only. SDR membership/access and its currency composition are not adopted.
